title: Lima (tour begins)
glance: Tour starts with a 2 PM welcome meeting and an easy leader-led walk downtown. You've already seen Lima well — today is about meeting the group.

picks.name: Huaca Pucllana
picks.note: Pre-Inca adobe pyramid rising out of the city; lit at night, restaurant on site.

picks.name: Optional group dinner
picks.note: Relaxed first night with fellow travellers; leader will suggest a spot.

notes: Don't miss the 2 PM meeting — it's where insurance & emergency details are collected. Late? Tell reception.
